## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- None. The certificate explicitly proves the interval presentation and \(A_+=(h_1,h_2,h_3,h_4)\), identifies the complete Pieri relation lattice, and correctly deduces that both six-element generating families map to \(\mathbb Z\)-bases of \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\). It remains restricted to \(i=j=p=c=2\).
